tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with users, flowers, orders, order_items, and cart_items tables
Build Node.js/Express backend API with authentication, flower catalog endpoints, and cart management
Integrate Stripe API for payment processing and order confirmation workflow
Design and implement React components for Home/Catalog, Flower Detail, Shopping Cart, Checkout, Order Tracking, and Profile screens
Implement flower catalog browsing with category filtering and product detail views
Build shopping cart functionality with add/update/remove items and real-time total calculation
Create checkout flow with delivery address input, date selection, and payment integration
Implement order tracking with status timeline and email/SMS notifications
Build admin inventory management interface for adding/updating flowers and stock levels
Set up AWS S3 for flower image storage and implement image upload functionality
Implement responsive mobile-first UI with bottom navigation and touch-optimized components
Add user authentication and profile management with saved addresses and payment methods
Conduct end-to-end testing of complete order flow from browsing to payment confirmation

risks: Stripe payment integration may require additional testing and compliance verification before production launch
Real-time order tracking and notifications depend on third-party services which may introduce latency or reliability issues
Image storage costs on AWS S3 could escalate quickly with high-resolution flower photos and growing catalog
Mobile responsiveness across different device sizes may require additional design iterations beyond initial implementation
Stock management synchronization between cart and inventory could lead to overselling if not properly handled with transactions
